headline_rule: (type, register, surface) slice gets a recall/whole/PPV headline only with >=300 INDEPENDENT positive units; below that DESCRIPTIVE_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT, and the slice stays visible in the table

independence_status_vocabulary.INDEPENDENT: distinct source documents/conversations and template families, re-derived, not asserted
independence_status_vocabulary.INDEPENDENCE_NOT_MEASURED: template provenance/shape unknown; cannot count toward 300
independence_status_vocabulary.SYNTHETIC_ONLY: synthetic isolated path; evidentiary weight published separately from product text

axes.values: 10 native item types + DATE (separate line) + 55 v6 registry types + temporary-secret family (additional, own allocation)
22 frozen case kinds as a PROXY only; free_prose, typed_kv, nested_json, document, rag_chunk, tool_error must be mapped explicitly before a slice is called covered

known_underpowered_native_types_frozen_1.note: measured deficit, not an oversight; the count is independent identities from the frozen v5 corpus

types: plus the Q4 subclass scope if the owner includes it
synthetic_isolated_axis.support_status: SYNTHETIC_ONLY, kept in a separate column from product-text support

unacceptable: counting a repeated template family twice
filling a hard register with easy registers
using authored gold as the PPV frame
dropping an unsupported type from the table
declaring a slice covered by the 22-case-kind proxy alone
